title: usage.json (v1)
description: Persistent quota counters, rewritten atomically under state/usage.lock (docs/storage-format.md §9).

bytes.description: Sum of payload.bin sizes still on disk.

items.description: Number of paste directories, including consumed and deleted ones not yet removed.

recomputed_at.description: Unix time of the last full recomputation by the purge.

generation.description: Incremented on every change and every completed creation; the hourly recomputation is applied only if it did not change during the scan. Optional: files written before it existed are read as generation 0.
